edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: 22s at rank 1 — the shield-dash absorbs your burst, so force it out first, then engage the long window. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Emperor's Divide is 120s — commit when it's down.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: When Conquering Sands whiffs he has no threat for up to 14s — step in, land E-Q on the flux, and back off before soldiers reset.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: W is the only spell that stops his Shifting Sands step-up; throw it into poke and his shield-dash goes unanswered for 11s.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP feeds the same map plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes, so the trade is even. Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks a mispositioned Azir before he stacks soldiers. The lane is yours to play.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA spike: your combo now out-damages his soldier poke and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you avoided.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you out-burst him outright: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Azir wins by poking with soldiers you cannot answer, eating your burst with the Shifting Sands shield, and never letting you root him.
